items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: Navarro can take the same solo... Navarro was -- as you say, was a mechanical Dizzy Gillespie.

ctx.x: When I say mechanical, I don't mean exactly mechanical. In order to sample the difference between one and the other one, Dizzy was (inaudible) and Navarro can take the same solo, huh, and (inaudible) and play (inaudible).
So he would have taken a technical (inaudible).
